description.en: Straight answers from the field — the things clients ask us before commissioning their first survey.
description.sw: Majibu ya moja kwa moja kutoka uwanjani — mambo wateja hutuuliza kabla ya kuagiza upimaji wao wa kwanza.

question.en: Do I need a survey before construction?
question.sw: Je, nahitaji upimaji kabla ya ujenzi?

answer.en: Yes — and it's the cheapest insurance you'll ever buy. A topographical survey feeds your architectural designs, engineering plans, and county approvals, and it surfaces site realities (slopes, utilities, boundary positions) before they become costly change orders. Building on assumptions is the most expensive mistake in construction.
answer.sw: Ndiyo — na ni bima nafuu zaidi utakayonunua. Upimaji wa topografia unaendesha michoro ya usanifu, mipango ya uhandisi, na idhini za kaunti, na unafichua hali halisi za tovuti (mtelemko, huduma za chini ya ardhi, nafasi ya mipaka) kabla hazijawa mabadiliko ya gharama kubwa. Kujenga kwa dhana ni kosa la ghali zaidi ujenzeni.

question.en: How long does a survey take?

answer.en: Most projects take 1–3 days of fieldwork and 2–7 days of processing and drafting, depending on the size of the site, the terrain, and the deliverables you need. We confirm a clear timeline with your quotation — and flag any delays early, not at handover.
answer.sw: Miradi mingi huchukua siku 1–3 za kazi uwanjani na siku 2–7 za kuchakata na kuchora, kulingana na ukubwa wa tovuti, mazingira, na matokeo unayohitaji. Tunathibitisha ratiba wazi na nukuu yako — na tunaonya ucheleweshaji mapema, si wakati wa kusaini.

question.sw: Mnaweza kugundua huduma za chini ya ardhi?

answer.en: Yes. We use Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR) — including the LMX200 — alongside utility mapping techniques to locate buried water lines, power cables, and other infrastructure before you excavate. It protects your crew, your budget, and your programme.
answer.sw: Ndiyo. Tunatumia Rada ya Kupenya Ardhi (GPR) — ikiwemo LMX200 — pamoja na mbinu za ramani za huduma kutambua miundombinu yaliyozikwa kama mabomba ya maji na nyaya za umeme kabla ya kuchimba. Inalinda timu yako, bajeti yako, na ratiba yako.

question.en: How much will my survey cost?

answer.en: Boundary surveys start from KES 30,000+, topographical surveys from KES 50,000+, and drone mapping from KES 25,000+. Because every site is different, we price on size, terrain, and accessibility — request a custom quotation and we'll turn it around quickly.
answer.sw: Upimaji wa mipaka huanza KES 30,000+, topografia KES 50,000+, na ramani kwa droni KES 25,000+. Kwa kuwa kila tovuti ni tofauti, tunabei kwa ukubwa, mazingira, na ufikivu — omba nukuu maalum nasi tuitolee haraka.

answer.en: We're based in Nairobi (Ruiru) and work across Kiambu, Machakos, Kajiado, Mombasa, Kisumu, and Nakuru — with full crews regularly deploying to Uganda, Tanzania, Somalia, and the wider East Africa region.
answer.sw: Makao yetu ni Nairobi (Ruiru) na tunafanya kazi Kiambu, Machakos, Kajiado, Mombasa, Kisumu, na Nakuru — na timu kamili inapelekwa mara kwa mara Uganda, Tanzania, Somalia, na mkoa mzima wa Afrika Mashariki.

answer.en: Professional, ready-to-use outputs: topographical maps and contours, boundary and cadastral plans, 3D point clouds, DEM/DSM models, CAD shapefiles, orthomosaics, volumetric reports, and signed survey reports — formatted for engineers, architects, and approval authorities.
answer.sw: Matokeo ya kitaalamu yaliyo tayari kutumika: ramani za topografia na kontua, mipango ya mipaka na cadastral, mawingu ya pointi za 3D, mifano ya DEM/DSM, shapefiles za CAD, orthomosaic, ripoti za kiasi, na ripoti za upimaji zilizosainiwa — zilizopangwa kwa wahandisi, waakitekti, na wamiliki wa idhini.
